selection: Experiments matched to the original website curve legends and labeled points. All available checkpoints from those variants are retained.
shared_initial: The initial point is the dense-sampling evaluation reused in the original curves. The v19 training code copies the initial dense dataset/checkpoint; model files are not included in the export.
uncertainty: Exact nonparametric bootstrap distribution of the mean of 100 binary rollout outcomes: Binomial(n, successes/n) / n, shown over its central 95% interval. This is evaluation sampling uncertainty, not training-seed variation. At 0% and 100% the empirical bootstrap is degenerate.
